mentions.name: Go circuit simulator
mentions.description: A circuit simulator written from scratch in Go as a fun personal project, built alongside relearning electrical engineering topics. The author does all the coding and architecture decisions personally, using an AI assistant only as an ADHD focus aid to stay on track, log ideas and experiments, and provide cited references to documentation, specs, and research.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a circuit simulator (the dumbest and slowest version of one, I’m sure) from scratch in Go for fun, alongside relearning electrical engineering topics via clanker.
mentions.author: ok_dad
